Chiffre d'affaires hors taxe ; coût = qu: Revenue excluding tax; cost = quantity sold × average purchase cost excluding tax (estimate). Products never bought and free-text lines have no known cost: their revenue is counted separately, without margin. Credit notes are not deducted. If you charge VAT but recoverable VAT on purchases is 0 in the accounting settings, the cost stays tax-inclusive: the margin shown is then understated (set the VAT on purchases with your accountant).

L'exercice est l'année civile (1er janvi: The fiscal year is the calendar year (1 January to 31 December). Closing means finalising the year's accounts: expenses and income are cleared, the result is recorded, balance sheet balances are carried to the next year and the period is locked. Do it with your accountant, after closing the cash register, reconciling the bank and counting the stock.

Le nom devient un mode de paiement : cho: The name becomes a payment method: choose it on a payment, an expense or a purchase to file it under this account, which will have its own reconciliation and its own ledger account (created automatically).
Méthode : la dépense est sortie du résul: Method: the expense leaves the result on the day it is booked (account 476), then at each month end the month's share goes back in, pro rata by days (exact rounding). On the balance sheet, the rest is an asset (prepaid expense) or a liability (deferred income). Have it validated by your accountant.
Méthode : linéaire, au mois entier à par: Method: straight-line, by whole month from the in-service month, charge booked at month end. Lives per category are indicative. No distinction between book and tax depreciation. To be validated with your accountant.
Repère calculé sur les retards passés (n: Guide computed from past delays (score out of 100). “Risky”: require a deposit or reduce the credit limit. Customers without enough history are not scored.
Situation cumulée depuis l'ouverture des: Cumulative position since the books were opened: closed fiscal years are carried into the equity accounts (result pending allocation or retained earnings). A cash or bank account on the liabilities side signals a negative balance or missing opening balances.

Un bien durable (matériel, véhicule, loc: A durable asset (equipment, vehicle, premises…) is not a monthly expense: it is recorded as an asset then depreciated over its useful life. The proposed lives are indicative: have them validated.
Une dépense payée d'avance (assurance, l: An expense paid in advance (insurance, a quarter's rent) weighs on the result only month by month, pro rata by days. The period starts on the 1st of the expense month at the earliest and ends after that month.
